rules.name: Directorate---Artillery_Attacks
rules.description: All Directorate Artillery Attacks use the Barrage, Scatter and Terror Weapon MARs with 5D6 Attack Dice.

rules.name: Directorate---Sky-Drop_Capability
rules.description: Initial Drop Site Markers are set to 6. Initial Artillery Markers are set to 4.

rules.name: Directorate---Tactical_Bonus
rules.description: Directorate forces have a Tactics Bonus of +1.

rules.name: Directorate---Logistical_Strength
rules.description:
Directorate Forces may spend up to 5 Logistics Points in a single Bid Action.
• Directorate Forces may elect to spend Logistics Points during the Play TACs Step of the Pre-Turn Phase to place Squadrons on Overwatch:
• It costs 1 Logistics Point to place a Light Squadron on Overwatch.
• It costs 2 Logistics Points to place an Armoured Squadron on Overwatch, unless it is a Heavy Armoured Squadron (identified as having the word Heavy in its designation) or Leviathan Squadron (identified as having the word Leviathan in its designation) which
cost 3 Logistics Points to place on Overwatch.
• Aerial Forces may NOT use Logistics Points to be placed on Overwatch unless specifically noted.
• In the case of mixed Squadrons (A Squadron made up of Light and Armoured Elements for example) use the largest Logistics Cost.

rules.name: Instructions
rules.description:
****** REMOVE THIS SELECTION BEFORE PRINTING ******

Natural Allies will appropriately be removed from the roster, but Allied forces require the appropriate "Select if a x or y Helix is taken as an Allied Helix" to be added in order to calculate.

****** NOVEMBER 26th ORBAT ******

The Infantry from the Nov 26th ORBAT have been added in combination with the infantry from the Sept 1st ORBAT so you can choose which stats to use until one is made official.

sharedRules.name: Aerial_Assault
sharedRules.description: This Squadron may fire its Main Ordnance while moving Flat Out provided the target squadron are Flying models – These shots are considered to be Rushed.

sharedRules.name: Artillery_Support(1)
sharedRules.description: May use the Artillery Support rules on Page 82. An Artillery Strike may be called in by a Model with a Nexus Designator instead of firing at a friendly Drop Site this turn. The Drop Site MUST still be in range of the Designator, however. Once an Artillery Strike has been resolved, it is lost (and the Sky Drop Marker is removed from play).

sharedRules.name: Artillery_Support(3)
sharedRules.description: May use the Artillery Support rules on Page 82. An Artillery Strike may be called in by a Model with a Nexus Designator instead of firing at a friendly Drop Site this turn. The Drop Site MUST still be in range of the Designator, however. Once an Artillery Strike has been resolved, it is lost (and the Sky Drop Marker is removed from play).

sharedRules.name: Assault_Vehicle
sharedRules.description: Models embarked may elect to activate immediately after the Assault Vehicle has finished its activation.

sharedRules.name: Bulky(2)
sharedRules.description: These units take up 2 slots in transports.

sharedRules.name: Cannot_Combine
sharedRules.description: The AA-256 Scrambler may not combine with the Peacemaker Missiles in Firing Solutions

sharedRules.name: Cloaked
sharedRules.description: Explosive Dice (red) ordnance is rolled as Heavy Dice (blue) instead.

sharedRules.name: Command_Centre
sharedRules.description: A Force that contains a Arbiter Command Barge may take an ADDITIONAL Tactical Action Card over and above the number stated for the game size. In addition no friendly Dindrenzi forces within the Arbiter’s Command Radius are required to take Disorder Tests due to the loss of their own Command Element.

sharedRules.name: Command_Element(12")
sharedRules.description: All helix squadrons in 12" gain an additional morale die when testing for disorder. If this model is detroyed all squadrons in the helix must take a disorder test requiring two successes.

sharedRules.name: Command_Element(16")
sharedRules.description: All helix squadrons in 16" gain an additional morale die when testing for disorder. If this model is detroyed all squadrons in the helix must take a disorder test requiring two successes.

sharedRules.name: Command_Element(8")
sharedRules.description: All helix squadrons in 8" gain an additional morale die when testing for disorder. If this model is detroyed all squadrons in the helix must take a disorder test requiring two successes.

sharedRules.name: Communications_Intercept
sharedRules.description: When Deployed on the battlefield, ALL enemy elements within 12” of a Haunter Disruption Tank may not gain a bonus die to their Disorder Tests due to being within the Command Range of their Command Element.

sharedRules.name: Cyberattack_Booster
sharedRules.description: ALL friendly elements armed with Cyber Attack weaponry within 8” of this model may choose to add or deduct 1 from the result rolled on the Cyber Warfare Table.

sharedRules.name: Dogfighter
sharedRules.description: This Squadron may ignore the Sectored Armour MAR when targeting Flying models. Flying Target models may therefore suffer Flanking or Rear penalties to their Damage Rating when attacked by a Dogfighter!

sharedRules.name: Drone
sharedRules.description: Drones within range of a Drone Nexus become Regular and gain +1 CQB.

sharedRules.name: Drone_Launcher(Arbiter)
sharedRules.description: The Arbiter Heavy Command Barge begins the battle with a TWO  Punisher Drones Embarked. The Arbiter Heavy Command Barge may Deploy its Punisher Drones at the end of any Movement Action. Once Deployed, the Drone forms part of the parent Squadron.

sharedRules.name: Drone_Launcher(Stalker)
sharedRules.description: The Stalker Drone Launcher begins the battle with a single Punisher Drone Embarked. The Stalker Drone Launcher may Deploy its Punisher Drone at the end of any Movement Action, provided the Squadron did not go Flat Out. Once Deployed, the Drone forms part of the parent Squadron.

sharedRules.name: Drone_Nexus(12")
sharedRules.description: Boosts Drones to Regular and gives them +1 CQB within 12". Each point of damage lowers the Nexus range by 4".

sharedRules.name: Drone_Nexus(16")
sharedRules.description: Boosts Drones to Regular and gives them +1 CQB within 16". Each point of damage lowers the Nexus range by 4".

sharedRules.name: Drone_Nexus(8")
sharedRules.description: Boosts Drones to Regular and gives them +1 CQB within 8". Each point of damage lowers the Nexus range by 4".

sharedRules.name: Drone_Repair_Facility
sharedRules.description: Any attached Punisher Drone MAY Embark onto its Drone Launcher during its Squadron Activation if desired. If it does so remove all Damage Markers from the Punisher Drone.

sharedRules.name: Drone_Repair_Function
sharedRules.description: The Stalker Drone MAY Embark onto its Drone Launcher during its Squadron Activation if desired. If it does so remove all Damage Markers from the Punisher Drone.

sharedRules.name: Embarked_Vehicle
sharedRules.description: The Wraith has a Haunter Medium Support Tank Embarked upon it at the start of the battle. The cost of this element is included in the overall cost of the Wraith. Once Disembarked, the Haunter joins the Leviathan Helix, and is treated as a separate Squadron in all respects.

sharedRules.name: Fearless
sharedRules.description: Unit never takes Disordered Tests.

sharedRules.name: Flying_Vehicle
sharedRules.description: When moving at Cruising Speed the unit gains Hard Target (-1), when moving at Flat Out the unit gains Hard Target (-2).

sharedRules.name: Grand_Company_Embarked
sharedRules.description: The Patriot Grand Company MUST be embarked on the Haunter Disruption Tank at the start of the battle.

sharedRules.name: Ground_Attack
sharedRules.description: This Squadron may fire its Main Ordnance while moving Flat Out provided the target squadron are Flying models – These shots are considered to be Rushed.

sharedRules.name: Hard_Target(-1)
sharedRules.description: Main Ordnance is -1 to hit this unit.

sharedRules.name: Hard_Target(-2)
sharedRules.description: Main Ordnance is -2 to hit this unit.

sharedRules.name: Hit_&_Run
sharedRules.description: May shoot and move OR move and move. May not move Flat Out if this rule is used. When shooting then moving, the unit cannot take advantage of Target Locks or Specialist Fire Orders such as Overwatch or Focused Fire.

sharedRules.name: Independent_Targeting
sharedRules.description: May target any target in range regardless of what the rest of the Squadron targets.

sharedRules.name: Kill_Team
sharedRules.description: +1 CQB stat when initiating CQB.

sharedRules.name: Logistics_Points
sharedRules.description: May use up to 5 points to bid on an Opposed Tactics test.

sharedRules.name: Lumbering
sharedRules.description: The model must use the turning template.

sharedRules.name: Recon_Specialist
sharedRules.description: The Squadron chosen may choose to make a free Flat Out Movement Action during the Recon Phase provided the move does not bring the Element within 16" of an enemy Model at any time during its movement.

sharedRules.name: Sectored_Armour
sharedRules.description: Model never suffers penalties to DR from Flank or Aft Main Ordnance attacks.

sharedRules.name: Shrapnel_Storm
sharedRules.description: ALL Directorate elements count their CQB Weaponry as having the Terror Weapon MAR.

sharedRules.name: Splash_Damage
sharedRules.description: All Attacks made by the Pacifier Plasma Cannon also have the Terror Weapon MAR (Disorder Tests caused by this weapon roll one less die.)

sharedRules.name: Strafing_Run
sharedRules.description: This Squadron may initiate a CQB Attack during its own activation while moving Flat Out provided the target squadron are Surface Models. These shots are considered to be Rushed.

sharedRules.name: Take_&_Hold
sharedRules.description: This unit may claim objectives.

sharedRules.name: Target_Lock
sharedRules.description: May use Nexus Designator to target an enemy unit befor the rest of the unit fires Main Ordnance. 0-3 hits : No Effect. 4+ Hits : Firing Squadron gains a placed bonus when firing their Main Ordnance.

sharedRules.name: Thunderous_Charge
sharedRules.description: The Leviathan may perform a Leviathan CQB Action after moving Flat Out.

sharedRules.name: Tracked/Wheeled_Vehicle
sharedRules.description:
Impassable Terrain : Vegetation/Forests/Jungle, Huge Rocks/Spires, Rivers (Non Lethal), Walkway (Buildings Only).
May not Flat Out over Rough Ground / Craters.
Increase Movement by 3" on  Roads.

sharedRules.name: Transport(10)
sharedRules.description: May act as a transport for 10 slots worth of Infantry.

sharedRules.name: Transport(12)
sharedRules.description: May act as a transport for 12 slots worth of Infantry.

sharedRules.name: Transport(Haunter)
sharedRules.description: May act as a transport for a Haunter Disruption Tank.

sharedRules.name: Transport(Patriot_Infantry_Only,_15)
sharedRules.description: May act as a transport for 15 slots worth of Patriot Infantry.

sharedRules.name: Walker
sharedRules.description: May not move Flat Out through Vegation or Rivers.

sharedRules.name: Weapon_MAR:Anti-Personnel
sharedRules.description: Weapon ignores Hard Target rules when targeting Infantry.

sharedRules.name: Weapon_MAR:Corrosive
sharedRules.description: Models damaged by this weapon, but not destroyed receive a Debilitating Effect Marker. These markets give -1 DR until repaired. Multiple Markers may be placed, but the effect is not cumulative.

sharedRules.name: Weapon_MAR:Cyber_Weapon
sharedRules.description: No damage. Ignores Shields. Only target non-infantry. Roll once for each DR beat. 1-2 : All Ordnance rushed, cannot Focus Fire or Overwatch. 3-4 : Debilitating Marker. 5 : Disorder Marker. 6 : Activation Marker.

sharedRules.name: Weapon_MAR:Interceptor
sharedRules.description: Flying targets do not gain the benefit of Hard Target against these weapons.

sharedRules.name: Weapon_MAR:Nexus_Designator
sharedRules.description: Weapon is used to reduce Sky Drop Markers micro dice.

sharedRules.name: Weapon_MAR:Pinpoint(3)
sharedRules.description: If a Pinpoint weapon damages, but fails to destroy non-infantry, roll 3d6. If one or more 6's are rolled, the target suffers an additional point of damage. If multiple weapons combine with Pinpoint, use the highest value only.

sharedRules.name: Weapon_MAR:Terror_Weapon
sharedRules.description: Disorder Tests caused by this weapon roll one less die.
